core_obligations: Reduce to the affine situation and express the count of geometrically irreducible components by a condition on a finitely presented algebra.
Apply the constructibility criterion for finitely presented morphisms to conclude local constructibility of the level sets.

proof_roadmap.step: Encode the geometric component count as a finite-presentation condition.

difficulty_reason: For a finitely presented morphism, the level sets of the function counting geometrically irreducible components of the fibres are shown to be locally constructible. The proof reduces to the affine case, expresses the count of geometric components of a fibre as a condition on a finitely presented algebra after base change to an algebraic closure, and then applies the constructibility criterion for such conditions. Encoding the component count as a finite-presentation condition is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 7806-7829.
